dict.string: 品質：1080p，場景 1600×900，邊緣平滑，最清晰，會發熱。效能：720p，場景 960×540，60 fps，流暢。省電：720p，場景 640×360，30 fps，Switch 螢幕大小，發熱最少、最省電。自訂：遊戲開始畫面「進階」裡選的設定。MetalFX：放大場景，更清晰、幾乎不吃效能；「場景＋螢幕」再放大到螢幕，最吃 GPU。遊戲開始畫面也可以改 · Quality: 1080p, 1600×900 scene, edge smoothing; the sharpest, runs warm. Performance: 720p, 960×540 scene, 60 fps; smooth. Economy: 720p, 640×360 scene, 30 fps, at the Switch's screen size; the coolest and lightest on the battery. Custom: what you chose under Advanced on the game's start screen. MetalFX: upscales the scene, sharper at almost no cost; "Scene + screen" also enlarges it to the screen, the heaviest on the GPU. The game's start screen has these choices too

開啟：遊戲的底座設定，輸出 1920×1080，畫面見下一行（原始 1600×900，和 Switch 底座一樣；高清 1920×1080，更清晰也更吃性能），iPad 預設開啟。關閉：手持 1280×720（內部 960×540），iPhone 預設。重新啟動遊戲後生效 · on: the game's docked settings, 1920×1080 output with the docked scene below (original: 1600×900, as the Switch docked; HD: 1920×1080, sharper and heavier), the iPad's default. Off: handheld 1280×720 (960×540 inside), the iPhone's default. Takes effect after relaunching the game
Full HD（底座模式）· Full HD (docked)
鎖 30 幀畫面更穩、手機更涼；遊戲中也可以點觸控按鍵中間的 60 / 30 切換 · 30 is steadier and keeps the phone cooler; the 60 / 30 button between − and + of the touch controls switches it while playing

未連接手柄、或手柄沒有陀螺儀時，用手機的陀螺儀與觸覺馬達；有陀螺儀的手柄接手後：碰螢幕換回手機，操作手柄交還。重新啟動遊戲後生效 · uses the phone's gyro and haptic actuator when no controller is connected, or the controller has no gyro; a controller with motion takes the aiming over until the screen is touched (its sticks or buttons take it back). Takes effect after relaunching the game
震动与陀螺仪只对支持的手柄生效。体感瞄准同时受游戏内选项影响。重新启动游戏后生效 · rumble and gyro apply only to controllers that have them, and motion aiming is also subject to the game's own option. Takes effect after relaunching
只对带触感的手柄生效；关掉后手机本身的震动也一起关 · applies to controllers with haptics; off also turns the phone's own vibration off
体感瞄准同时受游戏内选项影响 · motion aiming is also subject to the game's own option

外接键盘会自动识别。插着键盘时触控按键会隐藏，打开第二项可保留触控。重新启动游戏后生效 · a hardware keyboard is detected automatically; while one is connected the touch controls hide, and the second switch below keeps them. Takes effect after relaunching
使用外接键盘 · Use a hardware keyboard
关闭后键盘按键不再操作游戏，触控与手柄不受影响 · off: the keyboard no longer drives the game; touch and controllers keep working
插着键盘时保留触控 · Keep touch with a keyboard
默认隐藏触控按键，避免误触；打开后两者可同时使用 · the touch controls hide by default to avoid stray taps; on: both work at once
重启游戏后生效 · takes effect after relaunching
状态行（右上角）· Status line (top-right)
显示帧率、上屏尺寸和 MetalFX 是否生效；行尾是待补译的着色器数量 · shows the frame rate, the presented size and whether MetalFX is upscaling, ending with the number of shaders waiting for translation
着色器与管线（左下角）· Shaders and pipelines (bottom-left)
显示本次新翻译的着色器 / 缓存总数，以及本次新建的渲染管线；收集到新东西时会变黄 · shows the shaders translated this run against the cache total, plus the render pipelines built this run; it turns yellow when something new is collected

存檔仍保存在本機，副本放進所選資料夾。跨裝置同步需要相同的遊戲使用者 ID，顯示名稱相同仍會分開；新安裝的使用者 ID 不同。下次開啟遊戲時會出現資料夾選擇器，也可長按主畫面圖示選擇 · Saves stay on this device; a copy goes to the chosen folder. Syncing across devices requires the same game user ID; matching display names remain separate, and fresh installations have different IDs. The folder picker appears the next time the game opens; or long-press the Home Screen icon

開啟後把日誌寫進 App 的 Documents/log.txt（在 Mac 上讀取），會稍微影響效能；關閉時不記錄任何日誌。重新啟動遊戲後生效 · writes Documents/log.txt for reading on a Mac (slightly slower); off records nothing. Takes effect after relaunching the game

开启后，游戏会自动把公共清单里还没有的着色器贡献出去，让大家以后不再卡顿。只发送着色器和管线的标识、游戏和 App 版本、设备型号和系统版本号，以及一个随机编号 · When on, the game contributes the shaders the shared list lacks: identifiers, versions, device model and a random id only
自动贡献着色器 · Contribute shaders automatically
